mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and rises by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high consumer spending, a sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals strong demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS increases by >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increased over the past 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% and rising signals higher interest rates that compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand for housing and related goods, boosting corporate revenues and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increased over the past 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
